licences.owner: Monotype (designed by Robin Nicholas and Patricia Saunders, 1982); licensed to Microsoft, which ships it with Windows
licences.licence: Proprietary. The Windows licence lets the font be used on that machine and embedded in documents, not redistributed as a font file.
licences.rebuild: Not shipped. Only GameMaker's rasterised atlases of it (fnt_basic, font4, font7, font8, all byte-identical bakes of Arial 12) are imported, which is what the original game itself shipped.
